name: Label maker
summary: A handheld label maker for everyone's moving boxes: type what's inside, pick a tape color, print, and the embossed strip feeds out and sticks onto the next box in the group's stack with your face on it.
useWhen: 'label your boxes before saturday or they're going to the curb'
packing up and need to mark what's in each box
moving day prep, whose box is whose
lol someone label the rice cooker box
a fun way to tag the boxes before the move
dontUseWhen: deciding what to keep, sell or give (use box-sorter)
a shared to-do list for the move (use move-in-day)

labels.description: Labels already printed: who, the words (up to 24 characters), tape color 0 to 3
